q1_dependency_and_licence_inventory.syft_on_cargo_lock: Revision 1's run kept no raw output and no exit code. Rerun in revision 2 (exit 0, commands-r2.txt): 322 components, CycloneDX 1.6, 0 with a licence; summary and a digest of the component list in syft-cargo-lock-summary.json.
q1_dependency_and_licence_inventory.superseded: OVERSTATED (review M08-D-R04): cargo metadata resolves features for the whole workspace, dev-enabled features included, and skipping dev edges afterwards does not undo that. The macOS figure of 234 (224 + 10) includes 25 packages the selected graph does not hold (borsh, defmt, palette, time and others). The licence observation (every crate has a licence field and a permissive choice) covers a superset of the selected graph, so it still holds for it.

observed_result.q2_test_only_crates_in_the_release_build: Revision 2: 14 to 16 third-party crates are in the selected graph only through heimdall-testkit (per_target.only_through_testkit above): proptest, rusty-fork, tempfile, rand, rand_xorshift, chacha20, regex-syntax, bit-set, bit-vec, core_detect, fnv, quick-error, unarray, wait-timeout, plus fastrand on macOS and Windows and cpufeatures on Windows. The revision 1 list (16 to 20, with borsh, borsh-derive, proc-macro-crate, toml_edit) came from the metadata graph and is withdrawn. That the stripped binary holds no 'proptest' string is not evidence about linkage.

q3_macos_release_binary_static.reproducibility: RECORDED OBSERVATION, NOT REPRODUCIBLE: the binary was deleted after inspection. The commands were otool -L, codesign -dv, stat -f %z, shasum -a 256 and strings -a piped to grep -c per pattern; their individual exit codes were not kept. release-static-macos.txt is the summary those commands produced, not raw output.

q1_selected_graph_revision_2.what: cargo tree -p heimdall --target <triple> --edges normal,build: cargo's own package-, target- and feature-selected graph. It supersedes the cargo metadata figures below (review M08-D-R04).
q1_selected_graph_revision_2.normal_edges_are_not_linkage: A normal edge means the crate is compiled for the build; it includes proc macros, which run on the host. Nothing here says what the linker kept.

limitations: DESIGN PROBE (M08 design unit): observations that size M08 work items. It is not an A31, A33 or A34 record and carries no release claim.
Taken on main at de097dac, before M06 merges: M06 adds iroh (feature-gated), rustls and a vendored, patched netdev, so the counts will grow.
The single canary-marker occurrence was not traced to its source; the redactor's own marker constant is the expected one. The artifact scan in M08 must match full canary values, not the bare marker.
The release binary was inspected statically and never executed, so nothing here shows that it runs on a clean machine.
Revision 1's commands kept no exit codes, and its started_at is the date of the run, not a measured start time. Only the revision 2 commands listed in commands-r2.txt have recorded exits.
The cargo tree output is sanitized: workspace crates' paths are replaced by '(workspace)' and the '(proc-macro)' and '(*)' markers are removed.
No finding here is evidence about what the linker retained, about the absence of secrets or test code in the binary, or about clean-machine execution.
